title: Episode 13: The Exploding Whale of Oregon: A Highway Division's Blubber Blast
description: In November 1970, an eight-ton beached sperm whale washed ashore near Florence, Oregon. Because Oregon beaches were classified as state highways, the Oregon State Highway Division was tasked with disposal. Their solution—detonating half a ton of dynamite to disintegrate the whale—rained massive chunks of blubber over spectators and flattened cars.
